paper_container: Decision Corpus + Predictor Benchmark + Audit Protocol
question: On the fixed historical 931-pair same-pool test support, does UST edge weighting materially change the already-frozen pair-to-parent-to-task headline, clustered uncertainty or predictor rankings relative to uniform pair rows?

v1_invalid_attempt.invalid_reason: V1 omitted the existing generic benchmark headline that averages pair credit within parent, then parents within task, then tasks uniformly. Task-pair macro and global parent macro do not reconstruct this nested estimand when tasks have unequal parent counts.

not_computed_or_read_before_v2_freeze: per-pair UST effective-resistance weights on the historical support
historical support incidence rank and UST weight distribution
raw or UST nested task-parent headline for any predictor
UST-weighted pair-micro, task-pair-macro or global-parent-macro values
clustered interval for any UST-minus-raw shift
disclosure.classification_policy: Deterministic post-disclosure sensitivity only. The nested task-parent estimand is the headline because it was frozen on 2026-08-25, before this UST audit. Task-pair and global-parent rows are mandatory sensitivities and cannot rescue a failed headline. The dev-selected champion is never reselected on test.

estimands.graph_unit: Each connected component inside a fixed (task,parent) sibling comparison context.
estimands.edge_weight: Unweighted effective resistance b_e^T L^+ b_e, equivalently uniform-spanning-tree edge inclusion probability within that component.
estimands.normalization: Weights sum to incidence rank separately per connected component and globally by Foster identity.
estimands.headline: For every predictor, UST-weight pair credit within each (task,parent), average parent points uniformly inside each task, then average task points uniformly.
estimands.uniform_reference_headline: Replace UST weights by uniform pair-row weights inside each parent while retaining the same parent-then-task hierarchy.
mandatory_sensitivities: uniform and UST task-pair macro, where all pairs within task are pooled before task averaging
uniform and UST global parent macro, where all parents are averaged without outer task balancing
paired UST-minus-uniform shifts for nested task-parent, task-pair and global-parent metrics
paired UST predictor-minus-TFIDF deltas at the same three aggregation levels
estimands.ranking: Primary ranking uses nested task-parent headline points. Task-pair ranking is reported separately as sensitivity. No test-time reselection is performed.
estimands.champion_robustness: LOTO uses per-task nested task-parent champion-minus-TFIDF differences.

inference.headline_cluster_resampling: Resample the 28 task-level nested parent averages with replacement.
inference.task_pair_cluster_resampling: Resample the 28 task-level pooled-pair averages with replacement.
inference.global_parent_cluster_resampling: Resample (task,parent) points with replacement; this is sensitivity only, not the headline.

reported_frozen_champion_flags: headline UST nested task-parent CI lower endpoint above 0.5
headline paired UST nested task-parent delta versus TF-IDF CI lower endpoint above 0
headline paired UST-minus-uniform nested task-parent CI excludes 0
task-pair paired UST delta versus TF-IDF CI lower endpoint above 0
global-parent paired UST delta versus TF-IDF CI lower endpoint above 0
task-pair and global-parent UST-minus-uniform intervals exclude 0

independent_implementations.producer: Connected components plus symmetric Laplacian eigendecomposition and Moore-Penrose pseudoinverse.
independent_implementations.verifier: Independent component reconstruction plus grounded reduced-Laplacian inverse; it does not import the producer.
independent_implementations.numeric_tolerance: producer 5e-9 and verifier 2e-8 relative to max(1,magnitude)
synthetic_controls: K_4 gives edge weight 1/2 and total rank 3
a tree gives every edge weight 1
disconnected subgraphs inside one parent are separate components
tie or abstention receives neutral 1/2 credit
two tasks with unequal parent counts distinguish global-parent macro 2/3 from nested task-parent macro 1/2
raw-versus-UST ranking discordance is independently reconstructed

integrity.failure_policy: Any source hash, schema, support, hierarchy, graph, identity, trace, test, byte or arithmetic mismatch stops without scientific classification.

allowed: Whether UST/rank weighting is outcome-material or ranking-material on this already revealed historical same-pool benchmark.
Whether the previously frozen static champion remains above chance and/or superior to TF-IDF under the pre-existing nested benchmark headline.
forbidden: effective sample size or independent-label count
invalidity of any prior benchmark accuracy
